supportedMeasurements.model-full-height: Bind-pose vertical bounding extent; includes ears, raised tail and all retained source geometry. This is not withers height.
supportedMeasurements.model-full-depth: Front-to-back axis-aligned bounding extent; includes tail. This is not nose-to-rump or curved body length.
supportedMeasurements.model-longest-extent: Maximum of the three axis-aligned bounding dimensions.

contract.pose: Capture all corrected adapter local transforms BEFORE starting animation. Restore that exact rest pose on the export clone; raw inverse-bind reconstruction is only a fallback for unmodified source rigs. Static assets retain source pose. Never reset the live preview.
contract.defaultProvenance: editorial-preview-estimate; not inferred from a photograph and not a breed-standard measurement
contract.customProvenance: user-entered measurement with exactly matching measurement kind
contract.unsupported: withers height, nose-to-rump length, shell length, wing span or other landmark measures require per-base verified anatomical landmarks; do not convert using a fixed multiplier.
contract.catalog: Use the same physical-size module and measurementKind as export. Normalize source axes explicitly before selecting a preset axis. Store measured/estimated separately. Static sitting models must be labeled static source pose; cannot be equated with standing shoulder height.
contract.references: Breed reference ranges are comparative anatomical information only; they do not set whole-model dimensions.
contract.cloneProtocol: captureRestPose(root) once after normalization; copyRestPose(source,clone(source)) when cloning an already-calibrated catalog root; applyPhysicalSize(exportClone,{axis,cm,estimated,measurementKind}). Internal snapshot is removed from export extras.

references.bodyLengthRelation: Withers height : body length = 10 : 11; excludes head/tail bbox interpretation
Trunk length exceeds withers height by about 10–17%; not total nose-to-tail extent
Point of shoulder to rear point of croup is slightly longer than withers height

references.note: Square, compact body proportions. Do not infer a full-height centimeter default from this description or from a weight standard.
Substantial bone and rounded head/body impression; source does not provide a numeric full-model height. Fur changes apparent size.
Compact, powerful, medium-to-large body with short-to-medium strong legs. No numeric full-height default is justified.
Large, rectangular, substantial body and long tail. Weight information is not a geometric height or length conversion; no full-height centimeter value is supplied here.
